notes.title: Exodus Flight - My New Game!
notes.content:
I'm happy to present the new game I've been working on - Exodus Flight!

It's something a bit different, but there are elements that will feel familiar to Monsters' Den fans. I'm excited to be branching out and I hope you'll take a look!

The Kickstarter campaign is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/garin/exodus-flight-a-roguelike-starship-adventure]live now[/url]!

You can also wishlist the game on Steam below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2654280/Exodus_Flight/

notes.title: Operations End + New DLC
notes.content:
The final Operation, Silent Stone has ended. Thank you to everyone who took part! These community-driven goals were a fun experiment.

If you didn't manage to grab all of the reward artifacts, want them for future campaigns (or simply want to support me a little more!) the Protectorate Operations DLC is now available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1091060/Monsters_Den_Godfall__Protectorate_Operations/

Thanks for your continuing interest in the game. Have fun and good luck with your loot drops!

notes.title: v1.23 - The Archives / Operation False Idol
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25710805/2c299aed4d5c6f060b3924407633c50a452efc9d.png[/img]

[b]Operation False Idol[/b] has begun! Silence the lying Renouncers to earn the Pactkeeper artifact!


[h1]The Archives[/h1]

The Archives is a new location near Savantir that offers players the opportunity to track their collection of unique items and even create new ones. 

Donate items to be rewarded with a new resource: Embers of Creation. Once you have constructed the new Mystic Forge upgrade at the Keep, you can use Embers to create new versions of items from the Archives.

This update also includes three new achievements related to the Archives.

[h1]Other Changes & Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]The company vault now has a limit of 1000 items.
[*]Library research can be conducted using pages in the company vault.
[*]New consumable available at the Emporium - the 'Courier Sprite' allows remote access to the company vault.
[*]There is now a limit to how many months in a row can be spent resting. Complete a mission before you can rest again.
[*]In many stores the tier of items available for purchase can now be selected.
[*]'Badge' notifications added to Library and Keep Upgrades buttons.
[*]World dungeon quests reward a small amount of Embers of Creation.
[*]More items that grant skills now display the tooltips for those skills.
[*]You can now view the character sheet of characters in inactive parties from the company status screen
[*]You can now shift-click on the dialogue skip button to skip the confirmation message. 
[*]Inspecting an enemy now reveals if they have immunity to being instantly killed.
[*]Inspecting a summoned creature now reveals who summoned them.
[*]Redesigned time acceleration button for overland map.
[*]Improved plurals for enemy class names.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]The 'Elemental Mastery' passive skill now grants the resistance bonuses correctly.
[*]The Possessor no longer indefinitely increases his accuracy and stun resist with level.
[*]Turn order is now predictable when multiple characters act at once.
[*]Fixed a rare crash when entering battle (Error 1009).
[*] The 'slot appearance hidden' indicator on the paperdoll is now finally centered.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.22 - Shrine of Seganthea / Operation Burning Son
notes.content:
[h1]v1.22 - Shrine of Seganthea / Operation Burning Son[/h1]

This update brings a new method to increase the game difficulty for endgame players as well as several new activities, new items, bug fixes and other improvements. 

[h3]New location: Shrine of Seganthea![/h3]
[list]
[*]Visit this location to alter the World Tier
[*]World Tier increases the enemy level and grants additional rewards
[/list]

[h3]Added the first Operation! Operation Burning Son begins now![/h3]
[list]
[*]Advance your Operation Score by completing certain activities
[*]Reach the score threshold to qualify for a unique reward when the Operation ends
[*]Overall Operation progress is determined by collective contributions of the community
[*]View Operation progress on the Quest screen
[/list]

[h3]New mission type: Enemy Activity![/h3]
[list]
[*]These wave battles will appear on the map each month
[*]View activity status on the Quest screen
[/list]

[h3]Other additions:[/h3]
[list]
[*]New enchantment: Spark of Mystery. Turn an Epic item into an Exotic
[*]New enchantment: Loaded Dice. Cycle the affix on an item in a predictable pattern
[*]Added the option to scale the overland map, making it more usable at high resolutions 
[*]Overhauled notification system. Notifications now appear for slightly longer by default, but are dismissed if you mouse over them
[*]Added the option to disable power change numbers in combat
[*]Added the option to disable overland ambient audio
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed some bugs with dungeon levels / scaling
[*]Fixed bugs with Trollsblood Elixir
[*]Fixed using a Mysterious Shrine when the company is in debt
[*]Fixed bounty kill credit in wave battles
[*]Fixed experience granted by wave battles
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed the use of Figment of Madness on an item that already granted a skill
[*]Changed the allowed target items for Figment of Madness
[*]Fixed a bug that could occur with the layout of the character skills screen
[*]Changed behaviour of "Shortcut to Wisdom" shrine in Adventure mode
[/list]

notes.title: v1.21.4 - Pandora's Lair
notes.content:
This update brings new endgame content as well as a host of bug fixes and improvements!

[h1]Pandora's Lair[/h1] 
Visit the mysterious Pandora for the chance to face the ultimate challenge. This location is available after reaching Company Level 3.

[h1]The Standing Stones[/h1]
Revisit the Standing Stones to challenge them further for new rewards. This wave-based challenge escalates as you repeat it.  This activity is available after completing the 'Rite of Passage' quest (the first encounter with the Stones).

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[*] Factions now sell the ability to attune your Callstone to more locations
[*] New option to 'Rest' until the next month (in the two major cities)
[*] Ability to accelerate time on the overland map to move more quickly
 
[*] 2H Mace quickness penalty increased, damage slightly reduced
[*] Polearm damage slightly increased
[*] Character stats screen now has an entry for how many tonics have been used
[*] Added dialog box warning when restarting quest
[*] Historical challenge list is now in reverse order (most recent first)
[*] Changed method of background blur behind menu screens
[*] Altered arachnoid ability 'Defend the Hive' to be less powerful
[*] Changed quest assignment screen to try to make it clearer
[*] After browsing for custom portrait, automatically select 'use custom portrait'
[*] Autosave is now also triggered before entering a dungeon
[*] Options now save immediately on closing the options screen
[*] Made improvements to tutorial quest
[*] Newly created 'sprawling' dungeons will not be quite as big

[*] Fixed issues that could arise when characters had multiple turns (eg. with 'Keep Up')
[*] Fixed historical challenges to use the correct dates
[*] Fixed AI using invalid targets for resurrection
[*] Fixed 'Survivor' passive skill updating correctly
[*] Fixed effect of 'Exemplar' passive skill on summoned allies
[*] Fixed 'Steadfast' passive skill to protect against unmitigated damage (DoT, retaliation etc)
[*] Fixed the "Kick" skill, was incorrectly based on weapon tag instead of melee
[*] Fixed incorrect behaviour when a character has more than one "demands attention" buffs
[*] Fixed reset of bounty credits when starting a new campaign
[*] Fixed potential scripting errors when closing UI with the escape key
[*] Fixed a potential problem when speaking to the chamberlain at the start of the campaign
[*] Fixed skills sometimes using the wrong weapon animations
[*] Fixed the Executor changing form in Adventure mode

notes.title: Monsters' Den Chronicles - Remastered
notes.content:
If you haven't heard, Monsters' Den Chronicles - Remastered is now available on Steam! This entry in the series was a precursor to Godfall, but features a different structure built around advancing a persistent roster of heroes across multiple dungeons (each with their own story). 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121720/Monsters_Den_Chronicles/

If you want to go even further down memory lane, Monsters' Den: Book of Dread Remastered is also on sale this week to celebrate!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/502230/Monsters_Den_Book_of_Dread/

notes.title: Monsters' Den Godfall v1.20 - Adventure Update!
notes.content:
[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Introduces the long-awaited Adventure Mode, a new way to play. Take on weekly challenges or custom adventures in self-contained dungeons
[*]New Steam achievements for Adventure Mode
[*]Three new advanced classes - the Fanatic, Druid and Illusionist. They are unlocked by completing the campaign. If you've previously completed the campaign, loading any saved game will grant the unlock
[/list]

[b]Changes and bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed custom sprites/portraits on Mac 
[*]Fixed battle animation desync issue when taking turns too quickly
[*]Autosave is now triggered when descending dungeon floors
[*]Added additional explainer text to the anniversary missions
[*]Fixed a problem where character's passive abilities would sometimes not trigger at the start of combat
[*]Added more variety to Wandering Merchant's greeting 
[*]Gave a warning when quitting during battle in adventure/ironman
[*]Armor is no longer expressed as a percentage
[*]A new "% armor total" stat has been added
[*]'Corrosive' dungeon mod now uses "% armor total"
[*]Fixed saved game screenshots sometimes showing loading screen
[*]Changing tabs now has a click sound
[*]'Increase stats' buttons now make click sound
[*]Cleaned up tooltip behaviour during enchantment animation
[*]Daggers are no longer Restricted: Divine
[*]Fixed some dialog box issues
[*]Fixed some corner tooltip issues
[*]Gambler's Dice can now drop from city searches
[*]Ruin Scouting Reports can now can drop from bosses
[/list]

notes.title: Monsters' Den Godfall v1.18 Changelog - Achievements!
notes.content:
This update adds Steam Achievements as well as many bug fixes and other improvements.

[h1]v1.18.3[/h1]

[b]Important Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Party Assignments have been rebalanced. Party Strength has a much wider range making difference in character levels more meaningful. Most assignments are now more effective at the high end, but Reputation assignments are less powerful in general.
[*]'Ironman' mode - Can be selected when starting a new campaign. Difficulty can not be changed and only one save slot is available in this mode.
[*]'Switches' Puzzle Chest added to encounter pool for newly generated dungeons
[*]New item - 'Mind Leech'. Unlearns all skills and refunds skill points. (Keep Quartermaster)
[*]Keep Quartermaster has a new shop category: Special Orders
[*]All faction representatives have a new shop category: Special Training
[*]New cosmetic enchantments are available in Savantir
[*]Skill tree restrictions on medium and heavy gloves have been removed (Spellwardens rejoice!)
[*]Changed raw stat bonuses on shards to percentage bonuses
[*]Changed raw stat bonuses on equipment sets to percentage bonuses
[*]Orc 'Blood Rage' innate has had its regeneration reduced and broken into into a seperate condition that is disabled by Flame damage
[*]The influence penalty for losing in battle now scales up with mission difficulty
[*]Abandoned artifact quests now go back in the Library 'waiting' pool (no need to be researched again)
[*]Changed rarity tables for locked / puzzle chests
[*]'Circles' Puzzle Chest has improved animation
[*]'Arcturus' Wrath' skill - damage improved
[*]New resolution option: 3840 x 2160 (4k)
[*]Added/improved some skill animations - more to come
[*]Added a blur effect to the background behind the active window. This can be disabled in the options screen.
[*]The game now triggers an autosave after the tutorial ends
[*]New hotkey: can use 'Tab' to cycle through characters in inventory/character/use skills screens
[*]Removed character level label during deployment
[*]The quest complete screen now shows reputation totals that include the quest reward

[/list]

[b]Smaller Changes and Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*]'Inspecting the Keep' quest can no longer be restarted
[*]Fixed an issue where aborting a quest did not always remove the location from the overland map
[*]'Remove Tag' attribute is no longer hidden from tooltip (eg on Wraithstone)
[*]'Fall Back' skill fixed, immediately causes retreat
[*]'Cancels Health Regeneration' should no longer appear on tooltips twice
[*]Fixed an issue with some conditions that canceled health regeneration not behaving correctly
[*]Fixed several typos in conversation dialogue
[*]'Divine Power Sauce' no longer counts as using a Tonic
[*]Fixed skillbar issues arising when a Stolen Talent grants a skill the character already has
[*]Requested bounties can no longer spill over across saved games
[*]'Cult Collaborators' mission, fixed quest objective text
[*]Fixed an issue when selecting dead characters in 'Use Skills' mode
[*]Added more hints to shop screens about when new items become available
[*]Skill tooltips now reflect updated values after changing fighting style
[*]Exploration quests no longer tell you to descend if the unexplored floor is above you
[*]Fixed supply count disappearing from interface under some conditions
[*]Changed description of 'Architects Plans' item
[*]'Nature's Bargain' visual appearance corrected for female wielders
show highlight on quest tier selection
[*]Can no longer leave the roster screen if the active party is empty
[*]Fixed an extra party icon appearing when changing resolution on overland
[/list]

notes.title: Monsters' Den Godfall v1.17 Changelog
notes.content:
This is an update that brings some requested quality-of-life changes and numerous bug fixes.

[h1]v1.17.3[/h1]

[b]Important Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Damage mitigation effects now cannot reduce damage below 1. If a character is hit by a damaging attack, they will now always take at least 1 damage.
[*]Character stats screen and battle inspect screens now have tooltips explaining all statistics
[*]Higher difficulty settings now have an effect on experience gain and loot quality from battle (note that this does not apply to found treasure)
[*]New option for instant dungeon movement 
[*]Shops now have specific shopkeepers that can be spoken to for more information
[*]Additional tutorial dialog and new help popups
[*]Help bubble popups remember when they've been dismissed
[*]Hiring new characters in the first month of the game is now free, making it easier to change your starting party
[*]Tonics now work differently. No more 'liver damage', characters can use one tonic for each character level, at any time. Improved tonic tooltip to show how many more tonics the selected character can use.
[*]Cosmetic Enhancements now use their own special slot
[*]Improved handling of situations where all friendlies/enemies are hidden (now means none are)
[/list]

[b]Smaller Changes and Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fix for some 'missing dungeon' situations. Not confident enough yet to say 'all'. 
[*]Failsafe for situations in which an artifact would not appear in the target dungeon after loading a saved game. Should not longer be possible.
[*]The wandering merchant no longer changes his stock when loading the game
[*]Fixed that Hidden vfx wouldn't show when the condition was granted at start of battle
[*]Fixed bug where an enemy could ignore your hidden condition if they were the last enemy alive
[*]Clicking on the 'supplies left' indicator now also triggers the 'Use Healing Supplies' dialog
[*]Bounties now show which faction the target enemy belongs to
[*]Vault Screen: Added a hotkey for "send to vault on click" (hold Shift)
[*]'The Collector' quest can now be aborted (and taken again later). Quest description updated.
[*]Nekoatl allies have a battle portrait now
[*]World map settings (region names, show unexplored) are now saved between sessions
[*]Dreadfather's 'force retreat' skill can be countered by Resist Mental and Cannot Retreat stats on the target
[*]Fixed several issues with the Corruptor's 'Dark Mirror' skill
[*]Evil duplicates of player characters understand how to use more of their skills correctly (and no more friendly fire)
[*]'Disintegrate' skill changes to 'Scales with: None' (tooltip change only, functionality remains the same)
[*]'Intercession' skill properly removes conditions with only 1 turn remaining
[*]Changed many skill descriptions to be clearer 
[*]Changed skill upgrade text to explain what the Penetrating tag actually does
[*]Fixed messages incorrectly reporting unclaimed shipments
[*]Fixed an issue with lowering the game resolution while in battle
[*]Fixed behaviour of mousewheel in load/save game screen
[*]Double-clicking a saved game entry will save/load that slot
[*]Fixed some interface strings that were too long for their fields
[*]Fixed ability to customize characters created in older saved games (pre-December)
[*]Fixed global unlock of 'Tracker' class 
[*]Fixed wrong resolution of combat floating text in windowed mode
[*]Fixed incorrect "+1 item" notification on bag tab when enchanting with an item directly from a shop's inventory 
[*]Fix to character change animation in conversations (was showing at conversation link points, even when the same character was speaking)
[*]Fixed a rare bug that could cause the campaign to repeat after completion
[*]Added a visual reminder for how turn order is displayed (during deployment)
[*]Changed the color of the numbers on left and right of the action clock to better hint at their purpose
[*]Location field in older saves' menu no longer sometimes shows "[Location]"
[/list]

notes.title: Monsters' Den Godfall v1.16 Changelog
notes.content:
Smaller update that I wanted to get out quickly because it has a (tentative) fix for the 'missing dungeon' issue. If you continue to experience this with new quests created after this update please let me know so I can sink firmly back into despair.

Other changes:
[list]
[*]Exotic-rarity items better reflect the damage/armor of their Epic base item (deviation from the norm is preserved) 
[*]'Error resolving quest' when exiting dungeon is fixed
[*]The quest dialog now always shows the main quest at the top
[*]Reputation items now sell for slightly more than the faction will pay you
[*]The Thief subclass can now take both upgrades for the Sneak Attack skill 
[*]Fixed the black backgrounds behind some dialog boxes
[*]Superfically changed the when-hit effect on 'The Helm of the First Frostwarden' artifact to prevent conflict with other triggered effects
[*]Clones can no longer use the 'Fall Back' skill
[*]If a character is killed by their Animate Shadow being destroyed, their death sprite is now correct
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1 - The Bounty Hunters
notes.content:
The first major update to Monsters' Den Godfall is here!

[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]

[b]New Bounty Rewards[/b]
Completing bounty tasks is now more lucrative than ever before. Earn Bounty Credits and redeem them at the Hive for special rewards.

[b]New World Dungeon - The Shattered Stair[/b]
Since time immemorial it has ensnared the most powerful and ambitious. Accept the daunting challenge of this dungeon to earn exclusive new enchantments.

[b]New Advanced Class - Tracker[/b]
These bounty-hunting agents of the Protectorate use their Trickery and Nature skills to follow and subdue their prey.

[b]New Elite Missions[/b]
Each game month, face a selection of more difficult side missions with higher-level enemies and more powerful dungeon modifiers. Be rewarded with new skill manuals to further customize your heroes.

[b]Ongoing Research[/b]
Veteran artifact hunters can return to the Keep Library to continue their research. There's an endless selection of Legendary items waiting to be found.


[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]

[b]Defense Rating & Armor[/b]
Defense Rating now translates into Armor based on a curve. How effective it is depends on how much you already have- adding an element of diminishing returns. Player level is no longer considered in these calculations, making it simpler to understand.

[b]Artifacts[/b]
The damage and defense rating on Artifacts has been reduced. Characters that use multiple Artifacts at once will be put under strain and have their maximum health and power reduced.  

[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]All bosses now have a small chance to drop Exotic quality equipment
[*]Dungeon rarity has an increased effect on loot quality (higher than v1.0)
[*]The bonuses on some Shard enchantments have been adjusted
[*]Player skills that remove Wound conditions now also remove Bleed conditions
[*]The dungeon condition 'Fetid' is less powerful (look forward to the Elite version)
[*]Critical Hit Severity is now capped at 350% maximum
[/list]


[h1]Bug Fixes & Other Changes[/h1]

Other issues addressed in this update include:
[list]
[*]Overland encounter menu options now have more tooltip information
[*]Fixed problems with double-clicking items in the loot window (sometimes they would vanish)
[*]Fixed occasional issues with destination bags of unequipped items when equipping new items
[*]Fixed the effect of the Health Regeneration % stat
[*]Some skills have had their names altered to reduce confusion with other skills or effects
[*]'Hire Character' screen has a standard close interface button
[*]Minor improvements to item recommendations
[*]'Nature' summons should not have their sprites cropped when inspected
[*]Long company names handled better on company screen
[*]Found the tooltip for the skill 'Complete Heal'
[*]The 'Focused Fire' ability now only triggers on weapon attacks against enemies, as described
[*]Fixed being able to get multiple copies of the Nekoatl world quest
[/list]
